title: Limits of Resolution in Small Machine-Learning Benchmarks: Calibrated Inference for Clustered Test Sets (reproducibility package)
description:
Code, data and archived results accompanying the paper Limits of Resolution in Small Machine-Learning Benchmarks: Calibrated Inference for Clustered Test Sets.

The package contains qml_resolution, a small typed Python library (NumPy and SciPy only) for rank AUC, seed-averaged paired DeLong tests, cluster bootstrap and jackknife for clustered test sets, CR2 inference and minimum detectable differences; and the research pipeline of the paper: data processing, classical and hybrid quantum models (PennyLane + PyTorch), the 15-seed experiments, the archived per-seed validation and test probabilities of every model, and the analyses behind every table and figure.

The case study is a four-station Western Mediterranean monthly precipitation panel (windows 1938-2026; test years 2008-2026, 529 station-months in 19 calendar-year clusters). The analyses separate the test-set sampling error of AUC comparisons (DeLong and calendar-year cluster procedures) from the variance across training seeds. Tests check every number printed in the main-text tables against the archives.
